title: Quickshop Search Item
description: Easily search Quickshop shops with a GUI!
body:
QuickshopSearchItem is a simple plugin that allows users to easily search all the available Quickshop items that are available.

QuickShop doesn't have a built in system for easily searching chests, especially once a server becomes more established and there are lots of shops on the server.

Additionally, the plugin has a neat feature that allows not just searching for a specific item, but you can also search by an item's lore.

Command: ```/finditem```

**An example of the command usage (message is configurable)**


![An example of the command usage](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d4d55f95aafe8ce6a1eb827b848550bb89356ea.png)


**Filter between buying and selling shops**


![Filter between buying and selling shops](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0674fba77f46de4f8ac690365f1246c90370079c.png)


**Item Description**


![Item Description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6230dad5d2ceff2f61e0d8ff1f99a0edb1e1f38e.png)
